title: post match finish creates two pending split payments
description: Verify that when a match is marked as completed via POST /api/v1/matches/{match_id}/finish, the system automatically creates two PENDING split payment records, one per participant, with amounts equally split and formatted to two decimals.

title: post match finish with invalid match id returns error
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/matches/{invalid_match_id}/finish returns a 400 error response when the match_id is invalid or the match is not found.

title: post match finish payment creation failure does not rollback match completion
description: Verify that if payment creation fails after marking a match as completed, the match status remains COMPLETED, no payments are created for the match, and the failure is logged without rolling back the match completion.

title: get payments lists all payments with correct details
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/payments returns a 200 response with a list of payment objects including id, booking_id, match_id, user_id, provider, status, amount formatted to two decimals, and reference_code following the VMS-{booking_id}-P{user_id}-{rand} pattern.

title: get payments without authorization returns unauthorized error
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/payments without an Authorization header returns a 401 Unauthorized error.

title: get payments handles database query failure gracefully
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/payments returns a 500 Internal Server Error response when the database query to fetch payments fails.
